thread:
anya: dcgm-exporter just fired a bunch of ECC/Xid alerts across a couple racks in usw2. Getting paged repeatedly. Anyone doing maintenance?
omar: I see the same flood in the metrics view, looks like bursts on 3 different nodes but different cards each time.
jin: Not that I know of. Could be a noise burst from one kernel driver, or the time window is too tight.
lina: Paging right now — can we throttle the alerting or make it a warning for transient spikes? :eyes:
anya: Suggestion: change the rule to group by gpu_uuid and require sustained occurrences over a longer window. Current rule is spiking on single-sample blips.
dcgm-bot: automated note: dcgm-exporter v2.3.1 scraped 24 GPUs; 12/03 02:11:23 saw ecc_xid increments on gpu_uuid={gpu-8a1}.
omar: Proposed quick patch (P0 mitigation):
```
# before
alert: GPU_ECC_XID_SPIKE
expr: increase(dcgm_gpu_ecc_xid_total{job="dcgm-exporter"}[2m]) > 1
for: 0m
labels:
  severity: page
```
Change to: 
```
# after (suggested)
alert: GPU_ECC_XID_SPIKE
expr: sum by (gpu_uuid) (increase(dcgm_gpu_ecc_xid_total{job="dcgm-exporter"}[10m])) >= 2
for: 3m
labels:
  severity: warning
annotations:
  runbook: "https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-triage"
```
jin: That reduces noise and makes pages only when the same card is repeatedly failing. Also sets a cool-down with `for: 3m`.
lina: Agree. Also add `region` and `node` labels to avoid cross-region correlation false positives.
anya: Another idea: add a suppression alert that only pages if the cardinality of affected gpus in a node exceed N, e.g. >2 in 15m, for node-level impact.
omar: Example for node-level severity: 
```
alert: GPU_NODE_DEGRADE
expr: count_distinct_over_time(dcgm_gpu_ecc_xid_total{job="dcgm-exporter"}[15m]) by (node) > 2
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: page
```
(we don't have `count_distinct_over_time` built-in — we can approximate with `count(sum by (gpu_uuid) (increase(...)) > 0) by (node)` )
jin: We'll need to normalize exporter metric names and ensure `gpu_uuid` label is stable across node reboots. I saw a couple of cards reporting short-lived different UUIDs on kernel panics.
lina: Ops plan: 1) Patch prometheus rules to suggested 'after' version, 2) reduce page severity to warning for single-gpu transient spikes, 3) add node-level page rule for multi-gpu events, 4) annotate alerts with runbook and oncall rotation.
anya: I'll open a PR for the rule change and flag for rapid deploy. PR will include test cases (synthetic increase() samples).
omar: Also propose adding a short-rate limiter on alertmanager for `GPU_ECC_XID_SPIKE` to avoid paging flood when multiple cards flip in quick succession.
jin: Oncall note: if we still see repeated pages after the rule change, we'll start drains on the offending GPUs and schedule hardware triage. Add `drain_suggested: true` in the alert annotation if repeat within 30m.
lina: I'll update the runbook with the new thresholds and add the grafana panel links.
anya: Thanks team — deploying rule patch in ~10m. Will post PR link once up. :rocket:
anya: PR: https://git.redwood.internal/infra/prometheus/pulls/482 (patch rolling out in canary)
